question: g2_add_voucher
answer:
Done. `addToCart` now takes `promoCode` as its last parameter, and when it's truthy the payload gets a `voucher` field for both the add (`POST /api/v1/cart`) and update (`PUT /api/v1/cart/{code}`) requests; when omitted, the request body is unchanged.

The field name comes from the backend's cart-item request DTO `BasketLineInput` (`product`, `quantity`, `voucher`, `attributes`), which is what the add/update cart endpoints accept.

Files used:
- [cartActions.js](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/source/work/g2_add_voucher/source/codex/5/src/redux/actions/cartActions.js) — the only file changed (4 insertions, 1 modification, CRLF endings preserved)
- [BasketEndpoint.java](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/pr2/sm-shop/src/main/java/com/salesmanager/shop/store/api/v1/shoppingCart/BasketEndpoint.java) — confirmed the add/update cart endpoints
- [BasketLineInput.java](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/pr2/sm-shop-model/src/main/java/com/salesmanager/shop/model/shoppingcart/BasketLineInput.java) — confirmed the `voucher` field
